description: Search the Council's transparency resolutions, FY2018–FY2027: the changes made to the adopted budget's designations after adoption (new designations, rescissions, purpose-of-funds changes), from the checked tables BetaNYC reads from the resolution PDFs. Each row gives the resolution number and date, the chart, the budget year it changes, the organization, EIN, member, agency and amount as printed, with its status label ("checked, review in progress" or "checked and reviewed"), flags, review decision where decided, any hidden text (text in the PDF a reader cannot see on the page, always labeled), and its three links. Rows from charts that print no dollar amount are kept and never summed. Filter by fiscal_year (the resolutions' year), budget_fiscal_year, organization, ein, member (as printed) or council_member_id (exact Legistar person ID, resolved per year from the printed member), resolution_number (substring, e.g. '1013-2025'), resolution_date (YYYY-MM-DD) or a date_from / date_to range, action. Newest resolution first. Totals per kind of change cover every match. Needs the optional PDF tables download. Text filters ignore case and accents; a term of 3 or fewer letters and digits matches whole words only ('AI' finds 'AI-powered', not 'AIDS'), a longer one matches anywhere; whole_word true or false overrides that.

action.description: designate, rescind, purpose_from / purpose_to (a purpose-of-funds change), listed (a chart with no dollar amount)

budget_fiscal_year.description: The budget year a row's chart changes (a year's resolutions can change another year's budget)

council_member_id.description: Exact Legistar person ID of a council member (digits only, e.g. '7567' Stephen T. Levin, '7634' Mark Levine), matched on the row's printed member as resolved for its fiscal year by the repo's member crosswalk (data/pdf_council_member_crosswalk.csv, #72's rules, from the Council MCP's Legistar index). One person's rows are found under every label they were printed with ('Sanchez' to FY2026, 'P. Sanchez' in FY2027). Rows whose printed name is ambiguous (two members of that name served that year, e.g. FY2022 'Barron', FY2026 'Sanchez'), unresolved, a delegation, 'Speaker' or blank carry no ID and never match; the answer says which of them could be the person.

date_from.description: Resolutions dated on or after, YYYY-MM-DD

date_to.description: Resolutions dated on or before, YYYY-MM-DD

ein.description: EIN, exactly 9 digits, hyphens optional. Matches the organization's EIN or its fiscal conduit's

fiscal_year.description: The fiscal year whose resolutions to search, FY2018–FY2027

limit.description: Max rows shown, 1–500 (default 50; above 500 is capped at 500, below 1 is an error). Totals always cover every match.

member.description: Council member as printed (substring). A surname is not a person ('Levin' also matches 'Levine'; 'Williams' is two people in different years): the answer lists every printed name and person it matched. For one person, use council_member_id.

resolution_number.description: Resolution number (substring, always: an identifier, so whole_word and the short-term rule do not apply; '101' finds '1013-2025'), e.g. 'Res 1013-2025' or '1013-2025'

whole_word.description: Sets how name and prose filters match: true, whole words only ('AI' not in 'Jamaica', 'Fellow' not in 'Fellowship'); false, anywhere ('AI' in 'AIDS'). Omit for the default: a term of 3 or fewer letters and digits matches whole words, a longer one anywhere.

name: search_transparency_changes
title: Search transparency resolution changes
